record.field: company = env.company # The messages are chosen by the language of the user: in a data-only module, env._() resolves # to the module base (no Python frame of this module) and the code of an action is not exported # to the .pot, so ro.po cannot translate them. romanian = (env.lang or '').startswith('ro') # The standard synchronization fails with a technical error without these two (Odoo 19) if not company.vat: if romanian: raise UserError('Completați întâi CIF-ul companiei %s.' % company.name) raise UserError('Set the Tax ID of the company %s first.' % company.name) if not company.sudo().l10n_ro_edi_access_token: if romanian: raise UserError('Compania %s nu este încă conectată la SPV: Facturare (Contabilitate) > Configurare > Setări, E-Factura România, Generare token.' % company.name) raise UserError('The company %s is not connected to the SPV yet: Invoicing (Accounting) > Configuration > Settings, Romanian E-Factura, Generate Token.' % company.name) action = env['account.move'].action_l10n_ro_edi_fetch_invoices()
